# Six candidates do not satisfy the review. The item pauses and asks the owner to rule on the open findings.
# After the answer, the settle step applies the ruling once and the run ends. The pull request is not marked ready.
exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &

# The run has opened the store once the first agent call is in the record.
waitfile calls.log
waitstatus 'paused: The review loop used all of its rounds'

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning\tpaused: The review loop used all of its rounds'
! grep '^settle ' calls.log

exec beehave answer 7 keep the current API
wait
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone'

# The fixes after candidate k are fix round k, and the fixes inside candidate 1 are round 1 too. Each candidate has three scoped fixes:
# the hit of the implementer is due at once, so candidate 1 has three too. Five fix rounds reach candidate 6.
grep -count=6 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
grep -count=3 '^fix 5 ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 6 ' calls.log
grep -count=24 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^settle +[ab] keep the current API$' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log
